metadata.system: Vecna Unleashed chosen-set-membership sets (Cannith Repurposing Station / Lost Purpose)
metadata.note: The 44 Lost Purpose items awaken ONE of these 11 sets at the Cannith Repurposing Station (single-pick, mutually exclusive). Each set has a Heroic (ML18) and a Legendary (ML32) variant. Forbidden Knowledge is Profane and ALSO has fixed intrinsic members (Fire Over Morgrave raid weapons/shields + named orbs/trinkets/etc.), plus a multi-threshold 3/4/5 structure; the other 10 are Artifact, awaken-only, single 3-piece threshold. A few lines are a distinct 'Legendary' bonus type (Spell Critical Damage / Maximum Hit Points). Sourced verbatim from ddowiki 'Named item sets' section 'Vecna Unleashed sets' (pageid 9371, {{HELstats|Heroic|L=Legendary}}) via the same-origin MediaWiki parse API. piece_bonuses free text is parsed by src/set_parser.py under strict provenance; nothing inferred.
